fieldValues.title: Escalation: should heading-outline continuity be one rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition? (srs#991)
fieldValues.decision_question: Should a rendered document never skip a heading level (draft RFC-001 Revision 12, rule [N+39]), for every Composition, or only for Compositions that opt in?
fieldValues.context: Problem: a rendered page with an untitled section goes from a top heading straight to a third-level one (H1 then H3), which the agent pages on semanticops.com show today. srs#991 drafts the rule that closes the gap. Why it matters: it touches the Accepted RFC-001 text itself (Door 3), so the group cannot approve it, and the choice sets how many ways there are to decide heading levels (Conformance: one way over many, against Reliability: existing output stays as it is). Options and consequences: A. One rule for every document: one outline rule, but the 6 semanticops.com page Compositions change output, and downstream repositories such as muDemocracy.org were not audited. B. Opt-in property on a Composition: existing output stays byte-identical, at the price of a second way to decide level skipping. C. Do nothing: agent pages keep the H1 then H3 jump. Recommendation: A, as the builder drafted it. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low; srs#991 is a draft, no spec text changes until you merge it. Answers: SP-82. Reviewer rejected on escalation 2026-10-29.
fieldValues.friction: The draft RFC changes an Accepted RFC's own surface; no ruling covers it and the group's role excludes Door 2 and 3 changes.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A. Unconditional rule [N+39]. B. Opt-in Composition property. C. Leave as is.
fieldValues.key_requirements: One way to decide heading levels; no silent change to existing output; downstream impact known before it lands.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Approve option A: merge srs#991 as drafted, with the downstream audit (muDemocracy.org and other users of Compositions with untitled sections) done before the rule is folded into the spec.
fieldValues.rationale: A skipped heading level has one correct treatment; a switch adds a second way. The cost is a visible output change on 6 known pages, which can be checked first.
fieldValues.revisit_when: The downstream audit finds a Composition that must keep a skipped level, or the first consumer breaks on the changed outline.
fieldValues.next_steps: Owner picks A, B or C here or by merging srs#991. If B, the builder rewrites the draft as an opt-in property. If A, the audit is filed before any fold.
